name: Documentary
description: Cinematic and warm. Serif type, film texture, slow pushes, chapter titles.
vibe: A short documentary, not a social edit. Warm film grade with light grain. Serif captions, sentence case, never bouncy. Open with the letterbox effect over the first 3 seconds and a chapter-title or a quiet serif hook. Slow pushes (ease "push", 1.08-1.15) across whole sentences, never snap zooms. Use quote-card for the single most quotable line and chapter-title when the topic shifts. No emoji, no GIFs. The film-look effect at low strength across the whole video is welcome.
